summary.text: Julio Salinas is the Democratic candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 41, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Republican Gary Groves.
A legislative director at the Texas Capitol, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is co-chair of the Hispanic Caucus of the Texas Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Julio Salinas graduated from Sharyland Pioneer High School, attended the University of Texas Rio Grande Valley and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Austin.
His Ballotpedia profile lists his career experience as a legislative director.

In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey completed in 2026, Salinas described himself as a 25-year-old son of the Rio Grande Valley and of an immigrant farm worker, and said he has been a community organizer for over a decade.
He said he has worked as a state Capitol staffer, most recently as a legislative director, with a focus on the public health and transportation committees.
Salinas advanced from the Democratic primary runoff on May 26, 2026.
He said his campaign is built around affordability, labor and liberty.
